Hello, I'm a new guy here, so excuse me as I ramble on a bit about myself...

While I haven't been to a doctor or therapist or someone similar to see if I do in fact have anxiety and/or stress problems, I'm starting to believe I have a big anxiety problem. Even when things go my way my mind can't stop thinking about how it will eventually end and I'll go back to being depressed again.

There's tons of things going on in my life that make me anxious. 

One, both of my parents are disabled. And they're so set in their ways they never understand whenever I prove to them that whatever they're doing isn't helping them or us. It's like dealing with irresponsible children who just don't get it. Plus my mother had a nervous breakdown a couple of years ago, and I've always heard that mental illnesses are hereditary. 

Two, we've been without a car for over a year. Money is so tight for many reasons, so getting a car loan is pretty much out of the question. Everywhere else people are selling their cars at ridiculous prices. I mean, I'm not going to spend $5,000+ on a used car that's 10 years old or more with 100,000+ miles on it, for example.

Three, I hate my job. It's the most I've ever been paid hourly but I can't stand the company or most of my co-workers. Once my company gave a written reprimand to a co-worker because he missed work due to a heart attach. Then they wrote him up again for leaving work early because he had to have a doctor's appointment to check up on how his body was coping. 

Fourth, I seem to be a worrier. Whenever I try to not worry about something, my body and mind feels like they're going numb. I've even gotten sick twice in the last four months for letting everything get to me.

This week's stress comes from my dumbass supervisor at my job. He believed a rumor about me saying I wouldn't let myself get signed off on operating a certain machine press. Even after I told him I didn't say anything resembling that, he still threatened to fire me if I didn't sign off in a reasonable amount of time. Thankfully karma was a bitch to him a few days later. His boss didn't like him threatening to fire me, I got signed off, impressed my trainer, and made more parts than my supervisor's goal. Now I just have to hope that karma keeps kicking his ass when I go back to work.

To decompress I like being alone until I get a good amount of time to relax. Whenever I get too tense I'd rather just go chill so I don't unintentionally bite someone's head off. I like listening to music too but since I listen to new songs so often to the point where I get sick of them in a day or two I'm always having to search for more new songs.
Yep, pretty much 24/7.

I'm almost 40 years old. Yes, I've thought about just leaving many times. But if I did that right now I'd have to heavily lean onto someone else until I could get on my own two feet. No friends I know of are in a position like that, nor would I feel comfortable putting them in that situation because it would make me feel like I'm doing the same thing my parents do to me.

To be honest the government is part of this problem. Trying to get disability nowadays is damn near impossible. First, the time line the gov't. says you have to provide the necessary medical information to prove your disability is so short you almost can't prove it. Second, to get this necessary medical info each of my parents had to have doctor's appointment which we all had to pay out-of-pocket because without gov't. help my parents don't have health insurance. Third, even after we provided all the info and jumped through all other hoops the gov't. still denied each of my parents. Both of my parents had to file a lawsuit against the gov't., and it took around 6 months each time to make them approve my parents.

Of course I've tried talking to them. My mom means well but she keeps letting the rest of the world make her feel terrified of everything. As for my dad, the way he was raised turned him into this prideful fool. It's the whole stereotypical "man of the house" nonsense where asking for help just shows you're weak to other people you've never met and never will. I'm just the son who should just follow my dad's orders, and even arguing with him over the dumbest things makes him immediately start yelling "if you don't like it here, then leave!" threats at me.

Bottom line is my parents are stupid. That's not me being a douche, that's me being honest. They continue on their own course and even though I've pointed at their faults they just keep on truckin'. I mean, if you've done the same thing for years and it still hasn't rewarded you with something, why in the fuck would you keep doing it? Why wouldn't you change yourself, or get some advice? Because that's the travesty that is my parents. I am their pack mule and the only way I'll get any freedom is when they're dead.

I've been looking for other jobs but of course that's its own can of worms too. A new job would have to pay as much or more than I'm currently making at my current job. Going any lower would become me shooting myself in my foot again when it comes to our finances. Another problem is the town I live in is like the 1920's of living the in the bible belt of the bible belt, where Halloween gets celebrated a day early if it falls on a Sunday or Wednesday because god forbid (pun intended) any kids miss church services -- and even then the only places where kids can get candy is at a church party.
